exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists on npm yet (latest published is 3.0.3, the installed version); nothing to upgrade to until upstream ships a fix. Transitive dev/build-tooling dependency (chokidar/fast-glob/tailwindcss/eslint chain), not reachable from user input.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Only trusted organization code and repository-controlled build/lint tooling paths exercise this package. Review issue #910 on every dependency update and remove this acceptance once a patched braces release exists.

exceptions.reason: Fixed only in nodemailer 10.x, a major-version bump with a documented breaking API change versus the installed 9.x line; requires a reviewed upgrade of our transport/attachment call sites, not a blind bump. SMTP transport configuration is operator-controlled, not user input.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Outbound SMTP transport only; configuration (host/credentials/recipients) is operator-controlled, never derived from untrusted user input. Review issue #910 and remove this acceptance once the nodemailer 10.x migration lands.
